examples.label: Weekly digest preference row
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-toggle-field" site="Global" id="settings-weekly-digest" name="weekly_digest" label="Weekly email digest" description="A short summary of traffic, comments and form submissions, every Monday at 09:00." description_class="text-xs opacity-70 mt-1 mb-2 max-w-md" checked={true} />

examples.label: Two-factor authentication row, already enabled
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-toggle-field" site="Global" id="security-two-factor" name="two_factor" color="success" label="Two-factor authentication" description="Ask for a one-time code from your authenticator app at every sign-in." description_class="text-xs opacity-70 mt-1 mb-2 max-w-md" checked={true} />

examples.label: Maintenance mode switch in site settings
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-toggle-field" site="Global" id="settings-maintenance-mode" name="maintenance_mode" color="warning" size="small" label="Maintenance mode" description="Visitors see the holding page. Signed-in editors keep full access." description_class="text-xs opacity-70 mt-1 mb-2 max-w-md" checked={false} />
